## Physical Space Inventory — 1f_view.png

**Method note:** `view_pixel_region_overview` (background black, tol 60) produced 40 colour-connected blobs. Many (R01, R07–R09, R11, R12, R15, R18–R20, R22, R24, R16, R17, R30) sit outside the wall envelope (x≈249–611, y≈152–878) and coincide with the green/cyan dimension-line columns and text — these are **annotation regions, not rooms**, and are excluded below. Several interior blobs are split only by furniture (desks, cabinets, partial partitions) rather than full walls; these were merged back into single rooms after checking the original crops at 1.5×–2.5× zoom.

### 1. Top room (reception/open room)
- Extent: full building width, x≈258–602, y≈150–296.
- Evidence: candidate R03 (bbox [258,128,602,296]) plus furniture blobs R25/R28/R29/R37/R38 (sofa, cabinets) sitting inside it — furniture only, not separators.
- Openings: exterior door arc top-left (~x260–330,y100–150); a straight double-door glyph mid-top wall (~x400–420,y150) leading down into the central corridor.
- One continuous space; no internal walls observed.

### 2. Central corridor / circulation spine
- Extent: vertical band x≈397–463, running from the top room's opening (y≈296) down to the south exterior door (~x420–460, near y≈880/1140 "240" glyph); it also widens near y≈600–750 into the R02 blob (bbox [369,279,635,750]).
- Evidence: seed/candidate R02, R39, R40 (door-arc fragments), R35/R36 (small connector fragments).
- This is the main circulation: door-arc swing symbols recur at each junction (top y≈296–400, mid y≈403–460, y≈560–600, and near R05 at y≈700–750), each confirmed as a real jamb opening in the crops, not a solid wall.
- Uncertain: exact corridor footprint through the y≈600–870 zone is irregular (see R05 note below); treated as corridor/circulation rather than a room.

### 3. Left-upper office (R14)
- Extent: x≈258–397, y≈296–403.
- Evidence: candidate R14, furniture R26.
- Separated from top room by a full horizontal wall at y≈296 (with the corridor door gap only at x397–420); separated from the room below by a full wall at y≈403. Door arc into corridor at ~x370–420,y≈370–403.

### 4. Left-mid office (R10/R13, merged)
- Extent: x≈258–397, y≈403–587.
- Evidence: candidates R10, R13, furniture blobs R33/R34.
- A short partition line near y≈495 (only ~60 px wide, x258–320) does **not** span the room width — read as a low partition/counter, not a wall, so kept as one room with two workstation clusters. Door arc to corridor at ~x370–420,y≈403–460.

### 5. Right-mid room (R06, merged with R21)
- Extent: x≈463–602, y≈296–582.
- Evidence: candidates R06, R21, furniture R37/R38 (cabinet), plus two round-table clusters.
- A partial partition near y≈403 (x463–540) again does not reach the east wall — furniture/counter, not a room divider. Two door arcs connect this room to the corridor (~y296–400 and ~y460–580).

### 6. Bottom-left large room (R04, with table sub-blob R23)
- Extent: x≈258–397, y≈587–869 (oval-table meeting room).
- Evidence: candidate R04; R23 is just the table shape, not a separate space.
- Full wall at y≈587 separates it from room 4 above; door arc at ~x360–410,y≈587–650 connects it to the corridor. West/south sides are exterior walls.

### 7. Bottom-right room (R05)
- Extent: x≈403–602, y≈702–869, with a stepped/jogged wall at its NW corner (verified in the 2.5× crop: wall steps from x≈400 at y≈700 out to x≈460, then east to x≈520 before a door arc into the room near x≈520–560,y≈700–750).
- Evidence: candidate R05, furniture R27 (desk).
- This jog is a genuine drawn wall (double parallel lines), not a furniture artifact — confirmed enclosed room accessed only via the door arc from the corridor.

### Separators summary
- **Full walls** (solid double-line, verified in crops): between top room and left/right mid rooms (y≈296); between R14/R10 (y≈403); between R10 and R04 (y≈587); the jogged wall enclosing R05; and all exterior walls (x≈258/602 sides, y≈152/878 top/bottom).
- **Door openings** (arc symbols, real jamb gaps): top-left exterior entry, top-mid into corridor, corridor↔R14, corridor↔R10, corridor↔R06 (×2), corridor↔R04, corridor↔R05, and a south exterior door (~y≈878, "240" label) — circulation stays continuous through all of these.
- **Not separators** (furniture/partial partitions, ignored per instructions): short partition stub at y≈495 in R10; partial partition at y≈403 in R06; cabinet/sofa blocks R25/R28/R29/R37/R38; desks/tables throughout.

### Unclear / unexamined
- The exact solid-vs-open character of the small notch wall in R05's NW corner was read from one crop only; a second confirming crop was not taken (time budget) — flagged as the single re-check item, but geometry looked consistent (parallel wall lines) so treated as a real wall.
- The far bottom-center exterior door glyph (~y≈1140 region reported in dimension strip) was not independently re-cropped; its exact jamb pixel span is unconfirmed, only inferred from the "240" label pattern matching the top door.
- Exterior/annotation-only blobs (R01, R07–R09, R11, R12, R15, R16–R20, R22, R24, R30) were not further inspected since they lie outside the wall envelope and are dimension-line artifacts, per the overview's own bbox coordinates.

No metric dimensions, wall thicknesses, or BIM elements were computed; this is a spatial/topological inventory only.
